selection_rule_v9: Skip EXPOSED tasks (axios-5892, axios-4738, axios-4731) and the 2005/2006 setup examples.

Take the first 6 that pass qualification-v9 (setup + agent-input probe + grader calibration 3x empty RESOLVED_NO / 3x gold RESOLVED_FULL + 4 isolation controls + QB research visible channel runs on the base + clean-authored reviewed contract passes the controller validators), in CI, no model.
A task that fails qualification is replaced by the next in order, reason recorded, only before any model call. Never replaced for a model result.
The unlock(s) to build must be chosen by the senior on engineering grounds BEFORE any qualification result is seen.
current_fact: 0 of 23 fresh candidates are qualified or QB-compatible today. Every task that is qualified (2005, 2006, axios-4738, axios-4731, axios-5892) is exposed. Outside this pool, no pinned-image, no-service task in candidates.json passes QB's deps gate either (swe-bench-pro-v2: 50 Jest tasks, all element-web, all setup_missing_lockfile/yarn; polybench: no pinned images).
